claims.head: The Flyers want Zegras head to head with Fantilli
claims.call: The Flyers’ L1 (Zegras, Dvorak and Acciari) spends at least 68% of its 5-on-5 time against the Blue Jackets’ first line.
claims.body: At home, the Flyers keep sending Zegras’s line (Zegras, Dvorak and Acciari) out against opponents’ first lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Rick Tocchet has been choosing strength on strength. Tonight the Blue Jackets’ first line is Nichushkin, Fantilli and Johnson.

claims.head: The Blue Jackets’ edge in shots from defensemen
claims.body: The Blue Jackets are one of the league’s best for shots from defensemen, and the Flyers are near the bottom. It’s the widest gap between these two, though not a huge one.

notes.text: Ivan Provorov is on injured reserve (lower body injury) and has not played this season. He is a top-four defenseman. Jake Christiansen has taken his spot beside Denton Mateychuk.
Damon Severson was added to the roster on Oct 24 and has played beside Zach Werenski.

The forward lines keep changing. Even their four most-used trios over the last 10 games cover only 26% of their forwards’ 5-on-5 time, the fifth-lowest in the league (a typical team: 44%). The lines listed lean on their latest games, but expect new combinations tonight.
Owen Tippett is on injured reserve and has missed the last 4 games. He is a top-six forward.
Cam York has not dressed for the last 8 games. He is a top-four defenseman. Nick Seeler has taken his spot beside Jamie Drysdale.
Travis Konecny is on injured reserve and has missed the last 8 games. He is a top-six forward.
Cam York is expected back after missing 8 games. Their recent numbers were built mostly without him.

PHI.head: The Flyers start a half-step behind
PHI.body: Columbus has been out-chancing opponents lately, but Philadelphia has home-ice advantage. The Flyers can tip it if their power play gets going.

CBJ.head: Leaning the Blue Jackets’ way
CBJ.body: Columbus has been out-chancing opponents lately, but Philadelphia has home-ice advantage. Still, it’s close: the Flyers can make it interesting if their power play gets going.

story.head: Andrae returns to Philadelphia
paras: The Blue Jackets come in at 4-5-0, the Flyers at 3-7-3. Both teams are near the bottom of the standings.

items.text: Emil Andrae faces Philadelphia for the first time since leaving.
